title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 120
paragraphs: This is also strong evidence that it was so: Xerxes is known to have come to Abdera on his way back, and to have made a guest-friendship with them, presenting them with a Persian gold sword and a gold-spangled tiara. And as the men of Abdera themselves say (though I myself can by no means believe it), he loosed his girdle for the first time during his flight back from Athens, considering himself safe at last. Now Abdera lies farther toward the Hellespont than the river Strymon and Eïon, from which place the story says he embarked on the ship.
